key.name: border-width
key.description: Width in logical pixels of the white ring around each monitor.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Radius in logical pixels of the ring's rounded corners; 0 for sharp corners. The inner corner radius is this minus the ring width.

key.name: padding
key.description: Gap in logical pixels between the ring and the monitor edges, including the top bar and docks.

key.name: width-mode
key.description: How the ring width is defined: 'pixels' uses border-width, 'resolution' derives it from the available area resolution.

key.name: available-width
key.description: Desired work area width in logical pixels; ring width is derived from it in resolution mode.

key.name: available-height
key.description: Desired work area height in logical pixels; ring width is derived from it in resolution mode.

key.name: border-color-temperature
key.description: Color temperature in Kelvin of the ring light, from warm yellow (2700 K) to daylight white (6500 K).
